The '''Pugal system''' was a part of the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Pugali]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="MS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Pugali]]|system=Pugal [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pugal [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-7.<ref name="TEA" />
